entries.studio.localnotice: Local authoring · imports are not medical approval
entries.studio.footer: Iryomera Tools · own code MIT · source data retains its licenses
entries.studio.conflict: This document changed. Reload the page before saving again.
entries.studio.operationfailed: The operation could not be completed. Check the inputs and details.
entries.studio.introduction: Edit shared medical definitions, source evidence and translations. Keep simulation balancing separate.
entries.studio.syntheticnotice: Our MIT examples contain fictional software test data. They are not clinical facts and start unreviewed.
entries.studio.title: Project title
entries.studio.contentuploadhint: Choose an SDK content package. Import language catalogs afterward in Validation. Imported approval becomes a local draft; original metadata remains in the audit.
entries.studio.emptyprojects: No projects yet. Load the synthetic examples or create a project.
entries.studio.draftnotice: Editable local draft · approval and source rights are separate steps
entries.studio.name: Name
entries.studio.idhint: Content IDs stay stable across languages and saved games.
entries.studio.synonymhint: Shared synonym keys need actual matching translations. Independent imported aliases remain in original source metadata.
entries.studio.classificationhint: External classifications are sourced entries: system, value and provenance. Edit the structured JSON; never substitute a similar name for a verified identifier.
entries.studio.editresetsreview: Medical edits reset approval of this record and dependent relationships. Original source identity and license remain unchanged.
entries.studio.requiredresources: Required rooms, equipment, staff and resources
entries.studio.requirementshint: These quantities are simulation requirements. Use existing content IDs or clearly named resources. They are not clinical disease facts.
entries.studio.equipmentpersonnelhint: Equipment and qualifications below are derived only from explicitly authored examination/treatment links.
entries.studio.simulationnotice: Simulation / gameplay balancing only. No probability or cost here is medical evidence.
entries.studio.permissionhint: Additional third-party conditions require explicit evidence for this record's current content. A blanket project decision cannot override them.
entries.studio.permissionevidence: Permission / terms reference for the intended use
entries.studio.graphhint: Select a graph connection or its table button to edit it. Only explicit authored links are shown; the graph is limited to 12 lines for readability.
entries.studio.annotationhint: Edit structured medical context, not the immutable original source fields. Negation, qualifiers, frequency and provenance must stay explicit.
entries.studio.duplicatehint: These are editorial candidates, not automatic identity or medical equivalence.
entries.studio.diagnostichint: Advanced structured data: result types/units, sourced reference ranges, recommendations or explicitly separate simulation settings. Invalid references and medical evidence are checked on the server.
entries.studio.releasehint: Select records only after reviewing their clinical meaning. Export includes approved, reference-consistent content and both actual language catalogs. Additional source permissions remain mandatory.
entries.studio.rightshint: Use the operator and evidence fields above to record the actual license review. Do not include confidential permission documents in public exports.
entries.studio.rightsconfirmed: Project rights confirmed by the operator.
entries.studio.exportblocked: Export blocked: review, translations, references or permissions are incomplete.
entries.studio.importhint: Import a saved Phase 2 workspace JSON. Browse source claims, compare identifiers, record reviews and permissions, then create an editable draft from approved content.
entries.studio.uploadlimit: Maximum upload size: 32 MiB. No remote source is downloaded.
entries.studio.immutablesource: The uploaded original snapshot is immutable. Reviews and rights decisions are recorded separately.
entries.studio.sourcerightshint: Batch permission never overrides record-level OMIM/IEA/third-party restrictions. Use record scope and evidence for additional conditions.
entries.studio.promotehint: This first passes the importer release gates. The new local project starts as a draft and retains its source binding.
entries.studio.assetsnotice: Asset references are presentation data, not medical content. Purchased models stay in the game's private catalog; only their neutral IDs are stored here.
entries.studio.catalognotconfigured: No local catalog folder is configured (Studio:CatalogPreviewDirectory). IDs can still be entered by hand.
entries.studio.catalogerror: The local catalog list could not be read:
entries.studio.catalogassetshint: Neutral IDs such as iryomera.assets:wall.notice_board, resolved by the game's private catalog. Nothing is shipped with the content.
entries.studio.placementhint: Footprint in grid cells, mounting and surfaces other items can stand on. Placement rules such as free wall edges are checked by the game.
entries.studio.placementpreserved: Occupied cells and interaction points are kept unchanged.
entries.studio.assetsresetreview: Saving resets the review of this record only; its relationships keep their review status.
entries.studio.roomcontentshint: Furniture and equipment a player can place in this room type, from room relations. Items without a relation are not offered here.
